category: multi-host debrid (EU operator, Spanish-language storefront, EUR)

free_tier.stated: A 7-day trial, per the trial card on the same page: '7 dias para probar nuestro servicio', 'Verificacion por SMS', 'Pueden aplicarse algunas limitaciones (uso justo)'.
free_tier.notes: The trial requires SMS phone verification, and the card is rendered client-side so the wording is reported from the page's index rather than read in the extracted body. The trial is not a user's path: it ends in 7 days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: files stay on the third-party host, whose own cap applies. AllDebrid publishes no per-file size on the offer page.

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage is sold. The offer page says nothing about how long a generated link stays valid.

egress.terms: No byte allowance and no per-GB price. The page sells bandwidth as a property rather than a quota: 'Disponemos de un gran numero de servidores con un bando de ancha superlativo'. The English storefront states the company caps itself at 50% of infrastructure bandwidth to keep speed for users.

interface_detail: The API is documented separately at docs.alldebrid.com (v4, REST, JSON). The offer page itself only sells; the credential it issues works against the API.
tooling: REST API v4, browser plugins, mobile app, WebDAV access to the media folder, and named download managers (IDM, FDM, Mipony, Pyload).
chaining: A single EUR 3.99 payment covers 46-70 hosts plus torrent conversion with no account-sharing requirement beyond one person, which makes it the default benchmark every local generator and reseller has to beat on price or on payment access.
limits_note: No volume cap is published in EUR terms. The trial's 'uso justo' wording is the only admission that a fair-use ceiling exists.
binding_note: A single user on one connection downloading 1 TiB/month has no published byte cap to hit; the constraint that would fail first is the personal-use clause, and only if the account is shared. Nothing documents a volume failure at this scale.
price_per_tb_month: EUR 3.99 per 30 days one-time (USD 4.47 at 1.1205 EUR/USD); EUR 2.99 per 30 days on subscription

identity_cost.detail: Account creation plus email confirmation before subscribing: 'You must confirm your account by email before subscribing to the service'. Payment is 'Credit - Card Tarjeta de credito - Visa / Mastercard' or 'Crypto Bitcoin'. No local Latin American rail appears.

reliability_note: The Spanish, Italian, German and Portuguese storefronts are the same operator as alldebrid.com, so a localized price is not a local entity. Payment is card or Bitcoin only; a buyer whose card is rejected has no boleto or Pix fallback on this page.
confidence_note: All five prices, the two payment methods and the email-confirmation requirement were read on the Spanish offer page.

evidence.proved: the price ladder: '2.99 EUR / 30 dias' subscription, '3.99 EUR / 30 dias' one-time, 90 days 8.99 EUR, 180 days 15.99 EUR, 300 days 24.99 EUR
'Elige tu metodo de pago: Credit - Card, Tarjeta de credito - Visa / Mastercard; Crypto, Bitcoin' and 'You must confirm your account by email before subscribing'
the subscription terms: 'Using a credit card you will be billed every 30 days automatically', cancellable, versus 'Pago unico ... no recurrente'
'La cuenta esta pensada para uso personal unicamente. Solo la persona fisica y propietaria de la cuenta tiene autorizacion' - the clause every resold credential breaks

notes: This is the reference price the local market is measured against, in the language a LatAm buyer would read. The Spanish storefront accepts the same Visa or Mastercard a Mexican or Argentine bank issues, so a foreigner with a card can pay here without any local rail - which is precisely why the R$ 24.90 reseller listings only make sense for buyers with no usable card.

extras.fx: EUR to USD at 1.1205, ECB reference rate via Frankfurter for 2026-10-22; local prices kept as stated
extras.hosts_claimed: 46 on the English storefront price guide, 70+ on the Portuguese guide; the offer page itself gives no count
